newsitem.title: UK: Group 4 wins 49 mln stg court deal. [CORRECTED 14:40 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Group 4 wins 49 mln stg court deal. [CORRECTED 14:40 GMT]

text.p: Group 4, a privately-owned company, has won a contract worth 48.9 million stg over seven years to operate court escorting services in the North of England, Britain's Prison Service said on Monday.
(Corrects ownership of company from "...an associate of Sweden's Securitas AB")

Its director general, Richard Tilt, said the contract, won against stiff tendering competition, would save the British taxpayer some 2.5 million stg a year. It will be signed shortly. The deal means that Group 4 will escort prisoners from jails to courts in four of the eight prison regions of England and Wales. Northern England was the last British region to privatise this service.
